syncErrors.REMOTE_RESPONSE: The panel response is not recognized. Ask your administrator to check API compatibility.
syncErrors.STATE_UNSAFE: Routing state file permissions are unsafe. Contact your administrator; keep the original keys and recovery files.
syncErrors.PENDING_CORRUPT: The recovery record cannot be verified. Contact your administrator and keep the original record and key.
syncErrors.PENDING_BASELINE_MISSING: The recovery record lacks its previous published state. Contact your administrator and keep the record.
syncErrors.PENDING_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: A pending service configuration or authorization is unavailable. Contact your administrator and keep its recovery record.
syncErrors.PENDING_LIMIT: The pending recovery limit has been reached. Ask your administrator to handle the original failed jobs.
syncErrors.SERVICE_OPTIONS_KEY_MISSING: The encryption key is missing. Ask your administrator to restore the original key.
syncErrors.SERVICE_OPTIONS_BUSY: Routing is being synchronized. Check its status again shortly.
syncErrors.SERVICE_OPTIONS_CONFIG_INVALID: The saved service options are invalid. Ask your administrator to check the configuration.
syncErrors.SERVICE_OPTIONS_TASK_INVALID: The service options synchronization task is invalid. Ask your administrator to check it.
syncErrors.SERVICE_OPTIONS_TARGET_INVALID: The service target is invalid. Ask your administrator to check the service configuration.
syncErrors.SERVICE_OPTIONS_TARGET_CHANGED: The service target changed. Ask your administrator to finish disabling the original target.
syncErrors.SERVICE_OPTIONS_TIMEOUT: Routing synchronization timed out. Ask your administrator to check the job and panel state.
syncErrors.SERVICE_OPTIONS_SYNC_FAILED: Background routing synchronization failed. Give this error code to your administrator.
syncErrors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Background routing processing failed. Give this error code to your administrator.
